### Step 10 — Screen: Case Header — Control: Escalate
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S10`
If the guest is at the property and no alternative is confirmed within 30 minutes of the supplier log entry, escalate without waiting for further supplier replies.
**عربي:** إذا كان الضيف في مكان الإقامة ولم يتم تأكيد بديل خلال 30 دقيقة من تسجيل المورد، فارفع الحالة دون انتظار ردود إضافية من المورد.
**Expected result:** The case is in the Accommodation Support queue with the supplier log attached.
## Decision branches
- **If** The guest is already at the property. **then** Treat the case as time-critical and start the escalation in parallel with the relocation search. **Otherwise** Continue the steps in order. (continue at step 10)
- **If** Only later nights of the stay are affected. **then** Arrange relocation for the affected nights only and keep the original booking for the remaining nights.
- **If** The property calls back to confirm a room is available after all. **then** Reconfirm the original booking, release the provisional alternative, and add the reversal to the Supplier Log.
- **If** The verified cost difference is above the pre-approved limit shown in the Cost Recovery tab. **then** Request supervisor approval before confirming the alternative.
- **If** No equivalent-or-better option exists within the default distance filter. **then** Escalate to Accommodation Support and let the queue authorise a wider search.
## Do
- Confirm the refusal with the property directly before relocating anyone.
- Keep the original booking open until the alternative confirmation number exists.
- Record every supplier contact attempt, including unanswered calls.
- Give the guest a written confirmation, not only a verbal one.

## Steps
### Step 1 — Screen: Booking Detail — Control: Booking status chip
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S01`
Open the booking in AgentDesk and confirm on the Booking Detail screen that the status chip reads Confirmed. Note the booking reference and the room type.
**عربي:** افتح الحجز في AgentDesk وتأكد من شاشة تفاصيل الحجز أن حالة الحجز "مؤكد". سجّل رقم الحجز ونوع الغرفة.
**Expected result:** Status chip shows Confirmed and the stay dates match the guest's report.
**Screenshot reference:** `agentdesk-booking-detail-status` (original screenshot is attached to this step in the knowledge base)
### Step 2 — Screen: Case Notes
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S02`
Ask the guest whether they are at the property now, and record the answer on the case. A guest standing at the reception desk makes this case time-critical and changes the order of the remaining steps.
**عربي:** اسأل الضيف إذا كان موجوداً في مكان الإقامة حالياً، وسجّل الجواب على الحالة. وجود الضيف عند الاستقبال يجعل الحالة عاجلة ويغيّر ترتيب الخطوات التالية.
**Expected result:** The case records the guest's location.
### Step 3 — Screen: Supplier Contact — Control: Call supplier
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S03`
Call the property using the number on the Supplier Contact panel. Confirm the refusal directly with the property and capture the name and role of the person, the stated reason, and the number of nights affected.

**ملخص:** يُستخدم عندما يؤكد مكان الإقامة أنه غير قادر على استقبال ضيف يحمل حجزاً مؤكداً من Northwind Travel. أمّن إقامة بديلة مكافئة أو أفضل، وأبقِ الحجز الأصلي مفتوحاً حتى يصدر البديل، وسجّل فرق التكلفة المثبت، وأبلغ الضيف كتابياً.
## Also known as (search terms)
Agents rarely type the official title. These are the phrasings this procedure should also be found by:
- **English:** hotel has no room; overbooking; property overbooked; guest was walked; hotel refused check-in; no rooms available on arrival; hotel cannot host the guest; relocation needed; hotel turned the guest away
- **العربية:** الفندق ما عنده غرف؛ الفندق مباع بالكامل؛ الفندق رفض تسجيل الوصول؛ الفندق ما بيقدر يستقبل الضيف؛ نقل الضيف لمكان إقامة بديل؛ الضيف انرفض عند الاستقبال
## When this procedure applies
- The booking status in AgentDesk is Confirmed.
- The property states that no room is available for one or more nights of the stay.
- The guest has already arrived, or arrival is within 48 hours.
## When this procedure does not apply
- The property cannot locate the booking but has rooms available (use NW-HTL-021).
- The customer wants to cancel or change dates by choice (use NW-CXL-032).
- Two bookings exist for the same guest and dates (use NW-CXL-045).
## Information to collect before acting
- Booking reference
- Whether the guest is physically at the property right now
- Name and role of the property contact who refused
- Which nights of the stay are affected

## Do not
- Do not cancel the original booking before the alternative is confirmed.
- Do not promise any compensation amount that is not displayed in the Cost Recovery tab.
- Do not ask the guest to pay for the alternative themselves unless the Cost Recovery tab shows that option as available for this booking.
- Do not relocate a guest to a lower category stay without their explicit recorded agreement.
## Exceptions and special conditions
- If the guest chooses to end the trip instead of relocating, handle the cancellation as supplier-caused under NW-CXL-032 and note the link to this case.
- If the property is the only lodging inside the destination filter, escalate immediately instead of widening the search yourself.
- If the affected nights are more than 14 days in the future, the case is not time-critical, so follow the steps without the 30-minute escalation trigger.
## Escalation
- **Escalate when:** The guest is at the property without a confirmed alternative, no equivalent-or-better option exists, or the verified cost difference exceeds the pre-approved limit shown in AgentDesk.
- **Queue:** Northwind Travel Accommodation Support (Tier 2)
- **Channel:** AgentDesk Escalate button (live queue)
- **Response target:** The first-response target displayed on the escalation card
- **Approval required:** yes
- **Approver:** Accommodation Support Supervisor
## Suggested customer wording
Generated wording for the agent to adapt. It is not part of the procedure itself and carries no policy weight.
- **English:** I've confirmed directly with the property that they aren't able to host you for your booked dates. I'm arranging an equivalent or better stay nearby now, and I'll send you the new confirmation in writing as soon as it's issued. The verified difference in price is handled by us, so there's nothing for you to pay at the new property.

**عربي:** اتصل بمكان الإقامة على الرقم الظاهر في لوحة بيانات المورد. أكّد الرفض من المورد مباشرة، وسجّل اسم الشخص ووظيفته والسبب المعلن وعدد الليالي المتأثرة.
**Expected result:** The refusal is confirmed by the property, not only reported by the guest.
### Step 4 — Screen: Supplier Log — Control: Log supplier contact
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S04`
Log the call in the Supplier Log with the outcome "Cannot accommodate" and paste the details captured in step 3.
**عربي:** سجّل المكالمة في سجل المورد باستخدام النتيجة "غير قادر على الاستقبال" وأضف التفاصيل التي جمعتها في الخطوة 3.
**Expected result:** A timestamped supplier log entry exists on the booking.
**Screenshot reference:** `agentdesk-supplier-log` (original screenshot is attached to this step in the knowledge base)
### Step 5 — Screen: Relocation Finder — Control: Find equivalent stays
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S05`
Open Relocation Finder and search for equivalent-or-better stays for the affected nights, keeping the default distance filter around the original property.
**عربي:** افتح أداة إيجاد البديل وابحث عن إقامة مكافئة أو أفضل لليالي المتأثرة، مع الإبقاء على فلتر المسافة الافتراضي حول مكان الإقامة الأصلي.
**Expected result:** At least one option marked Equivalent or Better is listed.
**Screenshot reference:** `agentdesk-relocation-finder` (original screenshot is attached to this step in the knowledge base)
### Step 6 — Screen: Relocation Finder
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S06`

Present the shortlisted option to the guest and get their agreement before booking anything.
**عربي:** اعرض الخيار المختار على الضيف واحصل على موافقته قبل إجراء أي حجز.
**Expected result:** The guest has agreed to a specific alternative.
### Step 7 — Screen: Relocation Finder — Control: Rebook and Link
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S07`
Issue the alternative with Rebook and Link so the new booking stays attached to the original case. Do not cancel the original booking until the new confirmation number is visible.
**عربي:** أصدر الحجز البديل باستخدام "إعادة الحجز والربط" ليبقى مرتبطاً بالحالة الأصلية. لا تُلغِ الحجز الأصلي قبل ظهور رقم تأكيد الحجز الجديد.
**Expected result:** A linked alternative booking exists with its own confirmation number.
### Step 8 — Screen: Cost Recovery — Control: Add verified cost
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S08`
Record the verified cost difference in the Cost Recovery tab and attach the supplier evidence. The tab displays the pre-approved limit that applies to this booking; never quote a figure that is not shown there.
**عربي:** سجّل فرق التكلفة المثبت في تبويب استرداد التكاليف وأرفق إثبات المورد. يُظهر التبويب الحد المعتمد مسبقاً لهذا الحجز؛ لا تذكر أي مبلغ غير ظاهر فيه.
**Expected result:** The recorded difference sits at or below the displayed pre-approved limit.
### Step 9 — Screen: Messages — Control: Send template
**Step ID:** `NW-HTL-014#S09`
Send the guest written confirmation of the new stay using template HTL-RELOC-01, including the new address and check-in details.
